tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i phur pa sgrub mchod kyi skabs su tshogs skad gtong tshul gyi brda sbyor blo gsal sgo 'byed bzhugs// na mo gu ru badz+ra kī la ya/ phur sgrub chen mo'i tshogs skad gtong dgos kyi brda sbyor rnams phal cher sngar nged rang gi byas pa'i 'cham dpe nyung ngu gsum gyi gcig gi nang na mgo mjug tshang bar thus yod kyang / las dang po pa rnams la brda ston dang ngag gom pa'i phyir/ sgrub mchod kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du dgos pa'i tshogs skad nyung ngu re bkod par bya ste/ de yang 'cham sbyong snga ma'i chog sgrig gi skabs su/ 'o na gang ltar phur sgrub chen mo'i chog sgrig gi skabs 'dir sa chog nas sgrig dgos pas/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma sgrig par mdzad pa'i phyag len 'dug pa bzhin bsgrig par zhu zhes brjod/ dbu mdzad bskul res su yin gyis bskul nas sgrigs tshar ba dang / da sgrub thabs bsdus pa bsnyen sgrub gsal byed nang bzhin dbyangs rol dang bcas pa bdag skyed du mdzad nas gtor bsngo bshags pa grub mtshams mdzad dgos kyi/ sa sbyang ba dngos kyi rang gi mig g.yas par zhes pa nas/ bdag gi don yod dkyil 'khor bri zhes pa'i bar 'di sgrig par mdzad pa'i phyag len bzhin sgrig par zhu zhes brjod/ sgrigs tshar ba dang / da sta gon nas sgrig dgos/ bdag bskyed phur 'bring mdzad nas/ lha ston gyi mdun bskyed rkyang pa ma gtogs sgrig pa mi mdzad 'dug pas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs nas/ dam tshig la dgongs 'khod par 'gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas ye shes pa'i sogs nas/ 'khor ba phur bu'i bar sgrig par zhu zhes brjod/ sgrigs tshar ba dang / da dngos gzhi la sgrub thabs rgyas pa bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po'i sgrub tshul dang mthun par mdzad nas/ chog sgrig gi skabs 'dir bdag 'jug rkyang pa sgrig par mdzad kyin 'dug pa bzhin ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/

dad mos che bas dngos grub thob/ /ces pa'i bar sgrig par zhu zhes brjod/ sgrigs tshar ba dang / da mjug nas bkra shis 'di sgrig par mdzad pa'i phyag len 'dug pa ltar da lan yang mdzad pa zhu zhes brjod/ sgrigs tshar ba dang / 'o na gang ltar da lo'i phur sgrub chen mo 'di la dbyangs rol mo/ /cho ga phyag len/ dus chen skabs na bza'i zab spros mdzad dgos sogs gang spyi'i sar so so nas blo khur bskyed pa'i bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa zhig dang / sde bstan pa'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur nges rang dgos rgyu yin pa so so nas nges pa dang / phur sgrub kyi 'cham sbyong sngan ma'i skabs 'dir/ rol 'gros nas brtsam/ mgo gug yan la pad skor re re/ snang srid dbang du bsdu ba dang / mkha' 'gro dpa' skyed pa gnyis steng 'og bar gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ rdo rje rkyang 'gros rnams la lnga pad/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rgya khram/ me/ sa/ rak+ta/ rkang rus rnams la pad skor gnyis re/ rin chen lnga las grub pa dang / dam can spyi'i bskul 'cham nas/ sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros kyi bar sogs la 'cham grub po kha yar mdzad pas pad skor sku ngal bso ba sogs kyi stabs gang 'os mdzad la/ gzhan thams cad la pad skor re re/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rkyang 'gros tshar gnyis re/ rgya khram tshar gcig mdzad pa dang / /e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nas/ /rak+ta'i bar tshar gnyis re mdzad/ rak+ta dang / rkang rus mang tsam mdzad cing / 'cham sbyong rjes ma la pad skor lnga dgos pa rnams dang / sku ngal bso ba'i pad skor sogs ma gtogs thams cad la pad skor re re mdzad la/ rak+ta dang rkang rus mang tsam mdzad cing / gzhan 'cham sna tshang ma tshar re re mdzad/ sa 'dul dngos gzhi'i nyin/ mgo gug yan la pad skor gsum re dang / rdo rje phyed 'gros dang / rkyang 'gros tshar gsum re dang / rgya khram tshar gnyis mdzad cing / gzhan rnams grangs mang nyung pad skor sogs 'cham sbyong snga ma lugs mdzad/

de yang / chos dbyings bskyed pa/ snang srid dbang du bsdu ba sogs nas/ 'og byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar bskyod 'gros/ rdo rje rgya khram/ rkang rus/ rin chen lnga las grub pa/ rdo rje'i khyung shog yum chen/ phyag rnyan/ phra man gyi 'og phyogs pa gnyis/ byang sgo ba rnams la bskyod 'gros/ gzhan rnams la 'cham tshul dang bstun pa'i ldems 'gros gcig brdeg dang / bzhi brdeg kho na yin la/ mkha' 'gro dpa' bskyed pa nas/ dpal chen po'i 'gying chen yan la 'jol stabs/ 'gying chen nas byang sgo'i bar la grol bsdu/ byugs pa'i rdzas gsum la phur skor dang phur rtse phyi la ston pa nges par mdzad/ me'i dkyil 'khor gyi gru gsum gyi zur gsum ka la rol mo che ba brdeg e las ma dang / yaṃ las rlung chen gnyis la dzaṃ g.yas su gnon cing / waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor la g.yon du gnon/ thod rlon la rna ba g.yon gyi rtsa bar dzaṃ gsum byas la/ rol mo che ba drug la mdun nas bskor/ sna ba g.yas su sleb pa dang dzaṃ gsum byas la g.yon du ldog la grol bsdu bya/ sbrul rgyan la dzaṃ gsum dang rol mo che ba lnga'i bar la 'cham dngos gzhi bya zhing / glang lpags la g.yas bsig bzhi dang / g.yon bsig bzhi/ spel ma bzhi rnams byas la grol bsdu bya ste/ kha do ra la blta ba kho na yin cing / zhing lpags la kha do ra'i phyir bltas la g.yas bsig bzhi/ yang kha nang ltas kyi g.yas bsig bzhi/ de nas spel ma bzhi rnams byas la grol bsdu bya/ stag pags ni skyed pa'i sta zur g.yas su dzaṃ gsum byas la rol mo che ba bzhi la stag gi sham thabs dkri tshul gyi mdun nas bskor la g.yon du slebs pa dang grol bsdu bya/ baṃ brtag pa la g.yas nas g.yob pa la rol mo che ba gsum dang / brtag pa la chung ngu gsum/ g.yon pa la'ang des mtshungs/ g.yas g.yon re mos kyi g.yob pa la rol mo che bzhi dang / rtag pa la chung gsum yin la/ gang ltar 'cham sbyong dang dngos gzhi'i skabs thams cad du pad skor dang /

'cham sna rnams tshar du mdzad sogs thugs brel dang bstun pa yang phyag len la 'dug pa bzhin thams cad kyi 'cham dpon la ma yengs par gzigs nas zang zing du ma song ba dang / da lta ka 'cham sbyong las prug ste phebs pa zhu zhes brjod/ de nas stangs stabs sgrig skabs/ 'o na gang ltar stangs stabs sgrig pa'i skabs 'dir/ hūm̐ chen ka ra'i tshig bcad gcig yongs rdzogs la dbyangs mdzad pa'i tshig rkang dang po g.yas bskor gyi 'cham tshul nges tshig gnyis pa'i dbyangs kyi bar la pad skor gsum rdzogs pa dang / tshig bzhi pa la g.yas sig sogs kyi 'cham tshul dang / sngags kyi bar la pad skor gsum rdzogs par mdzad rjes/ g.yas skor mdzad pa dang / stobs po che la dbyangs sogs gzhan hūm̐ chen ka ra dang 'dra ba la/ tshig dang po'i 'cham tshul sngags kyi mjug gi g.yas skor g.yon skor du 'gyur ba dang / tshig gnyis pa'i dbyangs kyi bar dang sngags kyi ring la pad skor cha lugs go brje ba tsam yin pa 'cham sbyong gi skabs 'dir hūm̐ chen ka ra ma gtogs sgrig par mi mdzad pa'i 'cham tshul thams cad gtso bo la gzigs nas 'grigs par mdzad dgos so zhes brjod nas/ rang ngam gzhan gyi oṃ 'dren nas tsam ste 'cham dbyangs sgrigs tshar ba dang / da de'i rjes su steng phyogs tshang bsnol ma tshig ya mtha' ma mtha' bsdus pa'i dbyangs dang / kī la ya tshar gcig gi gdangs kyi bar la rdo rje 'dri ba'i 'cham tshul rnams lo re bzhin sgrig par mdzad kyin 'dug pa bzhin da lam yang sgrig dgos 'dug pas/ thams cad kyi gtso bo la gzigs nas 'grig par mdzad dgos zhes brjod la/ rang ngam gzhan gyi dzā 'dren nas bzung sgrigs tshar ba dang / des na de ring 'cham kyi skabs su 'grig po dga' rab yod mdog kha bas dngos gzhi'i skabs su yang thams cad kyi thugs rig sgrim nas dal brel ran pa dang / gral gyi bar thag snyoms pa sogs so so'i blo khul du nges pa dang /

da lta ka zhwa theb phod kha sogs gnang rgyu yin 'dug pas thams cad khas smad du bzhugs pa zhu zhes brjod/ de nas sgrub mchod zhag mang nyung gang byed kyang / skyed skabs tsam du sleb pa'i dbang sogs byed na tshogs skad gtong dgos/ dgong chog gi bkra shis grub mtshams/ 'o na gang ltar nged cag kyang do nub nas dbang tshugs rgyu yin pas/ sang nas bzung rnga 'cham kyi mgur 'degs pa sogs dbyangs pa rnams kyis dbyangs sbyongs dang / 'cham pa rnams kyis rnga 'cham grub 'cham sogs rang skyang pher nges so so nas sbyong lugs byed dgos yin pas/ de'i do dam 'cham slob pa'i slob dpon so sos mdzad pa zhu zhes brjod/ yang dbang mi byed na/ gong gi nged cag kyang dbang tshugs rgyu yin pas zhes pa'i tshig de dor bas chog pa sogs gang la yang skabs bab sbyor lugs shes dgos/ yang 'cham sbyong rjes ma'i nyi ma sngan ma'i dgong / rjes chog grub 'phral tshogs skad gtong dgos/ 'o na gang ltar 'cham sbyong rjes ma'i nyi ma'i skabs 'dir rnga 'cham nas dbyangs skor dang po gnyis re dang bstun 'cham skor gnyis re dang / rdo rje phyed 'gros rkyang 'gros/ sbal 'gros rnams kyang tshar gnyis re mdzad cing / grub 'cham la rkyang 'gros kyi dor nas/ dgug gzhug tshar gcig gi rjes su rol mo 'then rkang dang dzaṃ gyis rtsam nas/ pad skor dang rkyang 'gros tshar gcig gi rjes su seṅge'i brjid 'cham nas/ dred mo'i bar tshar gnyis re mdzad pa'i/ seṅge dang dred mo'i thog mtha' gnyis la rkyang 'gros dang / gzhan rnams la nyis 'gros kho na mdzad rgyu yin cing / 'cham sbyong gi skabs 'dir/ dred mo grub 'phral dgug gzhug mi mdzad par rol mo chems brdung dang / de nas g.yas log g.yon log ngos/ gdab kha'i 'cham tshar gcig gi rjes su/ dam tshig chen po'i sogs nas/ bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la babs/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ gdab tshul gyi 'cham lan gcig dang /

byang chub mchog tu nas/ bdud dang bar du sogs kyi rjes su gdab tshul lan gcig mdzad rjes/ de nas bgegs byed pa yi sogs dang / pho nya bran dang sogs dang / rdo rje gsang ba'i sogs dang / gdug cing sdang sems sogs dang / rdungs shig rdo rje sogs ste/ gang ltar dam tshig chen po nas 'di'i bar gyi gdab tshul gnyis dang / gdab kha drug gi 'cham rnams dang bstun tshig rnams ya mtha' ma mtha' bsdus pa dbyangs dang bcas pa'i bar la/ 'cham tshul mdzad pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin dang / gdab kha rjes ma'i chems brdung gi rjes su g.yas log g.yon log sogs grub mtshams gdab kha'i 'cham mi mdzad pa/ phyi nang gsang ba ma'i dbyangs yongs rdzogs 'cham dang bcas pa mdzad cing / 'cham sbyong rjes ma la rnga 'cham gyi dbyangs khor rjes ma re dang / 'cham 'khor kyang re re mdza grub mtshams la dgug gzhug gong bzhin dang / seṅge'i brjid 'cham nas brtsam dred mo'i bar 'cham 'khor re re mdzad/ gdab tshul gnyis pa dang / gdab kha khro bo chen po/ rdo rje gsang ba/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ sogs tshig ya mtha' ma mtha' sbyar ba'i gdab kha gsum po mdzad/ phyi nang gsang ba ma'i tshig ya mtha' ma mtha' gnyis mdzad cing / 'cham dngos gzhi'i nyin rnga 'cham la dbyangs 'khor gsum/ 'cham 'khor gsum re mdzad la/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rkyang 'gros gsum re/ rgya gram gnyis mdzad la/ grub mtshams la rkyang 'gros sogs 'chams/ dgu gzhug tshar gsum yang rkyang 'gros dang / seṅge'i brjid 'cham nas/ dred mo'i bar tshar gsum re/ de rjes dgug gzhug tshar gnyis/ de nas gdab tshul gnyis/ gdab kha drug phyi nang gsang ba ma rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad pa phyag len yin pas rol mo ba dang / 'cham pa kun gyi blo yul du nges pa'i zar zir du ma song ba'i 'grig rang zhig mdzad dgos pas spang blang 'jol med gnang ba dang / da lta ka 'cham sbyong la thams cad hrug ste phebs pa zhu zhes brjod/

sgrub mchod grol ba'i snga dro bshad pa dang / gsol ba chos spyod kyi mjug gi bkra shis sogs grub rje tshogs skad gtong dgos/ 'o na gang ltar de lo'i phur sgrub chen mo'i skabs kyi cho ga dbyangs rol 'cham sogs thams cad so so nas khur bskyed pa'i dga' rab rang byung bas rjes su yi rang zhing de ring gtor 'bul gyi skabs su yar 'byon mar 'byon sogs kyi skabs phyag cha rnams la thugs tog zhib pa dang bcas da lta thams cad gtor 'bul prug te phebs pa zhu zhes brjod/ de ltar gdan sa chen po'i phur pa sgrub mchod kyi tshogs skad gtong tshul gyi brda sbyor nyung ngu blo gsal sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di yang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin kho na snying dbus bsam pa'i sa skya pa chos med ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gi don du rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i dmar cha'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po dgongs pa chos dbyings su mnyam par gzhag pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i nyin kho na la mgyogs par sbyar ba 'dis bdag gi yid la re ba'i don 'di 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig de bzhin du 'gyur ba bla ma dang yi dam chos skyong rnams kyis mdzad du gsol/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal ldan sa skya'i phur pa sgrub mchod kyi skabs su tshogs skad gtong tshul gyi brda sbyor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
